title: OSR Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — Amendment No. 2 to Common Stock Purchase Agreement and Note Purchase Agreement
summary: OSR Holdings, Inc. (OSRH), a micro-cap Nasdaq-listed emerging growth company, entered into Amendment No. 2 to its Common Stock Purchase Agreement with White Lion Capital on April 7, 2026, introducing new intraday and fixed purchase notice mechanisms for share repurchases at 90% of VWAP. The company also executed a Note Purchase Agreement for a $1,055,555.55 Senior Secured Convertible Promissory Note bearing 5% interest, maturing in nine months, with a fixed conversion price of $1.00 per share.
key_points: OSR Holdings is a micro-cap emerging growth company listed on Nasdaq (OSRH) with a market capitalization well below mainstream attention
Amendment No. 2 to the Common Stock Purchase Agreement allows the company to deliver intraday purchase notices (90% of same-day VWAP) and fixed purchase notices (90% of three-day VWAP)
A threshold price adjustment provision exists: if stock falls to or below a specified threshold, purchase price may be based on 99% of that threshold price
The company issued a $1,055,555.55 Senior Secured Convertible Promissory Note with 5% per annum interest
Note is convertible at holder's option at $1.00 per share, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation (expandable to 9.99%)
The Note cannot be converted until six months from issuance unless an Event of Default occurs
Cash proceeds were $500,000 with $2,019,290 in existing warrant obligations effectively cancelled
why_it_matters: This filing represents a typical micro-cap equity line of credit (ELOC) and convertible debt financing arrangement. These structures are commonly used by smaller publicly-traded companies to access capital without traditional underwriting. From a macro perspective, this type of filing has no relevance to broad market structure, monetary policy, or macroeconomic catalysts. It is company-specific financing with negligible market-wide implications.
important_numbers: 5% — annual interest rate on the note
90% — VWAP discount for purchase notices under the ELOC amendment
99% — adjusted threshold price for certain purchase notices
